summary:
寶僑EPS小幅超預期2.2%，營收年增7.4%顯示品牌定價力支撑穩健有機成長。
• EPS 1.59美元，超出預期1.56美元，超預期幅度2.22%
• 營收212.3億美元，年增7.38%，顯示品牌組合與定價力穩固
• 必需消費屬性提供獲利防禦性與現金流穩定
• 高股息與穩定回購為股東回報核心
ai_view:
訊號穩健：EPS溫和超預期搭配7.4%營收年增，凸顯寶僑必需消費龍頭的定價力與防禦性。短期股價有穩定支撑，惟22倍本益比相對成長性不算便宜。中期須觀察價格貢獻退場後，銷量能否接棒驅動有機成長。追蹤指標：有機營收成長中的價/量拆分、毛利率、各品類市占、匯率影響與股息成長。

需留意：原物料與匯率波動可能壓縮毛利率；高基期下定價貢獻將遞減，量增成主要驅動；新興市場消費力與自有品牌（私有標籤）競爭

summary_en:
P&G modestly beat EPS by 2.2% with 7.4% revenue growth, as brand pricing power underpins steady organic growth.
• EPS of $1.59 beat the $1.56 estimate by 2.22%
• Revenue of $21.23B grew 7.38%, showing a robust brand portfolio and pricing power
• Consumer-staples nature provides earnings defensiveness and cash-flow stability
• High dividends and steady buybacks anchor shareholder returns

ai_view_en:
Signal is steady: a modest EPS beat with 7.4% revenue growth highlights P&G's staples pricing power and defensiveness. Near-term the stock has stable support, though a 22x P/E is not cheap relative to growth. Mid-term, watch whether volume can take over as pricing contribution fades to drive organic growth. Track: price/volume split within organic growth, gross margin, category market share, FX impact and dividend growth.

Watch：Raw-material and FX volatility could compress gross margins; Pricing contribution will fade off a high base, making volume growth the key driver; Emerging-market consumer strength and private-label competition
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期2.22%，營收年增7.38%反映定價與量穩健。
